topic: The town where every child drew the exact same nightmare for 40 years
hook: Every child in this town drew the same nightmare.
script: Every child in this town drew the same nightmare. In Canneto di Caronia, Sicily, children from unconnected families independently drew the same dark hooded figure for decades. Fires also spontaneously broke out on electrical items that were switched off. The Italian government investigated. Scientists investigated. Military investigators were brought in. No cause was ever found. The drawings continue. Follow for unexplained events that no one can rationally explain.
